args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate 18%). SRE rolled the service back, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error) and was retried successfully. Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout — INC-0001 is open with the on-call engineer paged. No need to retry (that would double-page).

**Summary of what I did:**

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back:** Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollout completed to all three regions.

3. **Verified:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

4. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2):** Describing the failure of v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0 (including the partial failure and retry), the verified recovery, and noting that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.
